info.name: TOEIC Mobile - Phase P Backend QA Live Smoke E2E
info.description: QA-only live Gateway smoke/E2E collection. Requires an isolated Backend QA overlay, sanitized seed registry, and two active QA accounts. Writes one exam attempt and logs both QA accounts out. Never run against production.

item.name: 00 - QA Overlay Preflight
item.description: Run first. The Gateway must be connected to the isolated QA overlay. GET /ready must return {status:"ready", qa:true}. Do not run against production.

request.description: Confirms the local API Gateway is ready and explicitly reports qa=true. Stop if qa is false.
